thread.listingTitle: Aircon room at Brisbane City, Brisbane

messages.text: Hi Jess, me and my partner are interested in living here. To share a bit about us… We recently moved from the UK on a working holiday visa for a year, and we both have full-time jobs here – I work as a medical receptionist, and Jamal works in sales. Previously, I was a probation officer in the UK, so we understand the importance of taking care of a home and being respectful tenants.
